data.case_title: Witness summons from Amtsgericht Musterquedlin (Case 2 C 318/26)
data.title: Witness summons - Amtsgericht Musterquedlin
data.summary: The Amtsgericht Musterquedlin summons Uwe Beispielharz to appear as a witness in the civil case "Beispielharz Dachbau GmbH gegen Marion Kessler" (dispute over payment for work, Werklohn). The hearing is scheduled for Wednesday, 13 January 2027 at 09:00 in courtroom 104 at the court.
data.explanation: A court has summoned you to testify as a witness about roofing work carried out at Bodetal 6 in May 2026. You must attend the hearing on 13 January 2027 at 09:00, bringing this summons and an official ID. If you fail to appear without a sufficient excuse, the court can order you to pay the costs caused and impose a fine (Ordnungsgeld), per §380 ZPO. You may be entitled to compensation for travel costs and lost earnings under the JVEG - ask the court's office if you have questions. If you cannot attend, contact the court as soon as possible to explain and request a different arrangement.
